title: What's New: Extending E-Documents with New Interface (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Problems to solve and design goals

features.name: I document sender interface
features.description: New interface for handling document sending with improved parameters including send context code unit as third parameter providing HTTP response and request information and data wrapper.
caveats: Replaces old e document integration interface for sending

features.name: I document response handler interface
features.description: New optional interface for handling asynchronous responses when sending documents to services that process and verify contents before responding.
caveats: Only used for asynchronous communication scenarios

features.name: I document receiver interface
features.description: New interface for handling document receiving with two functions: receive documents for getting metadata and download document for fetching actual document contents, eliminating need for is handled events.
caveats: Requires migration from old receive document and get document count approach

features.name: I received document marker interface
features.description: Optional interface to acknowledge receipt of documents to services that track received status to prevent duplicate sending.

features.name: I document action interface
features.description: New interface for standardizing document actions allowing connectors to implement custom service calls without managing state in the e document framework.

features.name: E-document framework error handling improvements
features.description: Enhanced error handling for receiving logic when integration services are unavailable, preventing unexpected e document states and maintaining framework control.

features.name: Send context code unit wrapper
features.description: New parameter providing HTTP response and request information wrapper passed as third parameter to sending interface implementations.

features.name: Receive context data template
features.description: Variable wrapper containing HTTP response and request data in receiving context provided to receiver implementations.

features.name: Updated Avalara connector
features.description: Avalara connector updated to use new e-document interfaces

features.name: Deprecated e-document integration interface removal timeline
features.description: Old e-document integration interface is deprecated and will be removed in three waves by 2026 wave 2.
